_meta.label: synthetic - illustrative
_meta.confidentiality: Fabricated values. The real SPN/FMI dictionary is TATA Motors proprietary and is not used or reproduced.
_meta.spn_range: SAE J1939 manufacturer-proprietary range 520192-524287, invented values
_meta.p_codes: real codes from the 3.3L DTC manual (except P0195, deliberately absent); the SPN/FMI -> P-code pairing is fictitious
_meta.dtc_low_byte: failure-type byte = the manual's suffix (P0192 + 00 -> P0192-00)

fmi_meaning.0: data valid but above normal operating range - most severe
fmi_meaning.1: data valid but below normal operating range - most severe
fmi_meaning.3: voltage above normal, or shorted to high source
fmi_meaning.4: voltage below normal, or shorted to low source
fmi_meaning.5: current below normal or open circuit
fmi_meaning.8: abnormal frequency or pulse width or period
fmi_meaning.16: data valid but above normal operating range - moderately severe
